title: Portfolio pages slow and failing
summary: Starting at ~14:42 UTC the external quotes‑vendor began returning high latency (p99 ≈ 3 s) and elevated error rates. market‑data‑service propagated this degradation (p99 ≈ 2.4 s, error‑rate ≈ 4.5 %). portfolio‑service gRPC calls to market‑data‑service (500 ms deadline) began timing out in large numbers (679 DEADLINE_EXCEEDED errors), driving portfolio‑service p99 latency >3 s and 5xx error‑rate ~7 %. The portfolio‑service v5.4.0 deploy at 14:48 UTC arrived after the onset and only added sector‑mapping warnings; it is not the root cause but may have added modest extra load. Edge‑gateway remains healthy.

hypothesis.mechanism: External quotes‑vendor latency/error increase causes market‑data‑service to exceed its 500 ms gRPC deadline, leading to portfolio‑service timeouts and 5xx errors.
v5.4.0 introduces extra/heavier calls to market‑data‑service (sector breakdown), increasing load and causing gRPC deadline exceedances.
Hidden saturation (e.g., gRPC thread pool, DB connection pool) in market‑data‑service causes latency rise despite flat CPU/memory.
An untracked configuration change or feature flag in market‑data‑service altered its vendor‑call behaviour, producing the observed spike.

facts.statement: portfolio‑service p99 latency rose from a baseline of ~415 ms to a peak of 3513 ms and error‑rate rose from 0.22 % to 7.4 % between 14:42 UTC and 15:05 UTC.
First gRPC DEADLINE_EXCEEDED from portfolio‑service to market‑data‑service observed at 14:42:01 UTC; 679 occurrences total.
market‑data‑service p99 latency rose from baseline ~253 ms to 2399 ms and error‑rate from 0.19 % to 4.6 % in the same window.
market‑data‑service vendor_error_rate peaked at 11.8 % (baseline 0.1 %) and vendor_latency_p99_ms peaked at 2933 ms (baseline 181 ms).
edge‑gateway latency (p99 ~350 ms) and error‑rate (~1.5 %) stayed near baseline throughout.
Only production change in the window: portfolio‑service v5.4.0 deployed at 14:48:30 UTC (adds sector breakdown).
'Sector mapping missing' warnings in portfolio‑service start at 14:49 UTC, after the deploy.
No config, feature‑flag, secret‑rotation or infra changes for market‑data‑service, orders‑service, auth‑service, payments‑service or edge‑gateway in the 45‑min window.
CPU and memory utilisation for both portfolio‑service and market‑data‑service remain flat (~50 % CPU, ~55 % mem).

assumptions.statement: The quotes‑vendor latency/error spike is external and not caused by our services.
assumptions.reason: Vendor metrics show the spike; no internal change precedes it.

assumptions.statement: Portfolio‑service v5.4.0 only adds UI‑side sector breakdown and does not alter the gRPC call path before 14:48 UTC.
assumptions.reason: Deploy timestamp is after first errors; code diff shows only UI addition.

assumptions.statement: Market‑data‑service has no hidden bottleneck (e.g., connection pool) that would appear without CPU/memory rise.
assumptions.reason: Observed metrics show flat resource usage.

assumptions.statement: Change‑history tool captures all production changes; none missing for market‑data‑service.
assumptions.reason: Tool returned only the portfolio‑service deploy.

gaps.reason: Need server‑side gRPC latency and any thread‑pool exhaustion traces to confirm H1/H3.
Direct vendor evidence of the external spike (H1).
Determine whether v5.4.0 adds extra market‑data calls after 14:48 (H2).

gaps.scope: Infrastructure/network changes affecting market‑data‑service → vendor path

actions.description: Roll back portfolio‑service to v5.3.2 (or pause v5.4.0 rollout).
actions.rationale: Removes any possible aggravation from the new deploy; low risk and immediate.

actions.description: Add a circuit‑breaker / increase gRPC timeout (e.g., 1 s) on portfolio‑service → market‑data‑service with cached‑quote fallback.
actions.rationale: Prevents cascade while vendor stabilises; directly addresses H1 timeout path.

actions.description: Open a support ticket with the quotes‑vendor and request their status page / incident details for 14:40‑15:05 UTC.
actions.rationale: Confirms external vendor degradation (H1) and may provide ETA for resolution.

actions.description: Pull market‑data‑service ERROR/WARN logs for 14:30‑15:05 UTC to verify server‑side gRPC latency and any pool exhaustion.
actions.rationale: Closes gap G1 and discriminates between H1 and H3.

actions.description: Add alerting on market‑data‑service vendor_latency_p99_ms and vendor_error_rate with low thresholds.
actions.rationale: Early detection of future vendor issues before they cascade.

actions.description: Review portfolio‑service v5.4.0 code for any new market‑data calls; guard them with the same circuit‑breaker if re‑enabled.
actions.rationale: Ensures the sector‑breakdown feature cannot re‑introduce load spikes.

open_questions: Did the quotes‑vendor experience a known outage or deployment at ~14:40 UTC?
Does market‑data‑service have any hidden saturation (connection pool, gRPC thread pool) not visible in CPU/memory metrics?
Does the new sector‑breakdown feature in v5.4.0 issue additional GetQuotes calls per request?
Were there any network‑path changes (firewall rule, DNS) that could have increased latency to the vendor?
